title: Estimate context sensitivity

knownEvidence: S03 found no independent-global-distance worsening among the 10,355 primary paper backtracks and only six primary S12 backtracks.
S07 exact necessity is confined to retained cell-view n=4-5 families; exact conclusions do not extend beyond n=9.
S10 strict global-distance filters often destroy small-n reachability, while adjacent-descents filtering is heterogeneous.
S11 open-loop and randomized structural nulls reproduce much of small-n completion and barrier contingency; 5,737 rate-matched runs have an infeasible requested category.
freezeBoundary.forbidden: No larger-n S12 outcome may be computed before this contract is written. Formula terms, populations, episode definitions, and escalation rules may not be selected from S12 outcomes.

frozenQuestion: How do independent-metric detour occurrence, depth, duration, recovery, completion, residual error, and cost vary with size, fault count and placement, policy composition, scheduler width, direction, and initial disorder under repeated matched scenarios?
claimBoundary: Larger-n results are empirical under a declared state-blind counter-addressed external opportunity scheduler and frozen E01 transition semantics. They are not exact reachability, necessity, universal scheduler, byte-exact historical replay, or evidence of anticipation.

largerNPopulation.pairing: All four intervention arms in a block share n, policies, direction, scheduler grouping, initial occupancy, replicate, and a counter-addressed raw opportunity root. Actor, Bubble-side, and conflict-priority tokens are state-blind and shared by address; proposals may diverge after states diverge.
largerNPopulation.longHorizon: Every replicate-zero run active at the primary budget is rerun from the identical initial state to 4 times the primary budget, with a required exact primary-prefix checkpoint.

schedulerAndTransitionSemantics.transitionAuthority: reference_simulator policy, validation, synchronous conflict, commit, cost, and terminal precedence semantics
schedulerAndTransitionSemantics.stream: SHA-256-rooted counter-addressed SplitMix64; actor/side/priority substreams are distinct and fixed before outcomes
schedulerAndTransitionSemantics.schedulerBoundary: This is a deterministic empirical scheduler intervention, not the scenario-ID-keyed SHA-256 E01 historical scheduler. Selected fixtures must agree opportunity-by-opportunity with the authoritative E01 engine supplied with the same external schedule and common priority interceptor.

episodeDefinitions.primary: A running-minimum excursion episode starts at an accepted occupancy-changing atomic batch checkpoint whose successor distance is above the best distance attained so far, and ends on the first such checkpoint returning to or below that anchor. A serial checkpoint contains one accepted swap; a synchronous checkpoint may contain multiple disjoint accepted swaps. Selection-memory-only batches do not create distance checkpoints. Depth is maximum distance minus anchor. Duration is charged opportunities from episode start through recovery; an open episode at stop is right-censored.
episodeDefinitions.positiveRunSensitivity: A positive run is a maximal consecutive sequence of accepted occupancy-changing checkpoints with strictly positive net metric delta.
episodeDefinitions.initialLevelSensitivity: Record whether and how far a trajectory ever exceeds its initial distance.
episodeDefinitions.necessity: No larger-n episode receives an exact necessary/unnecessary label. Exact S07/S11 small-n labels are summarized in a separate bridge table.

declaredStrata.structuralReachability: Retain exact S07/S11 reachable, unreachable-active, and quiescent strata only in the small-n bridge. Every larger-n row is explicitly labelled out_of_exact_domain_large_n.
declaredStrata.s10FilterExposure: For every larger-n run-metric, retain whether at least one accepted swap had positive selected-metric delta. This is a post-trajectory exposure stratum and is not a baseline predictor of detour occurrence.
declaredStrata.s11RateFeasibility: Rerun the identical native path using S11 systematic category requests targeted to that run's accepted-swap and Selection-memory rates. Retain unavailable swap, memory, and unchanged requests as a shadow native-path feasibility stratum; do not call it an executed rate-matched null.
declaredStrata.recurrentActive: Keep primary active, long-horizon complete, long-horizon quiescent, and recurrent-active-at-4x distinct; non-replicate-zero active runs remain not_assessed_long_horizon.
declaredStrata.opportunityRate: Retain the S11 opportunity-rate bins using accepted swaps per charged opportunity.

models.unit: run-metric, with four intervention arms clustered within matched scenario block and metrics fit independently
models.occurrence: Binomial GEE with exchangeable within-block correlation and fixed terms C(n)+C(policy)+C(scheduler)+C(direction)+C(disorder_profile)+scaled_initial_disorder+C(observed fault-count-by-location context)+C(intervention), plus policy:scheduler and policy:scaled_initial_disorder interactions. The fault context is one supported-cell categorical term; unsupported count-by-location combinations are not materialized as all-zero columns.
models.depth: Gaussian mixed model on log1p(max episode depth) among detour-positive runs, random intercept for scenario block, using the same fixed main effects and no outcome-selected terms; exchangeable Gaussian GEE is the declared singular-fit fallback.
models.duration: Discrete-time complementary-log-log recovery model over accepted episode-time intervals with scenario-block clustered covariance and right censoring; if row expansion is impractical, fit a Cox model with block-clustered robust covariance. No open episode is recoded as recovered.
models.completion: Binomial GEE with exchangeable within-block correlation on all runs. S10 exposure and S11 shadow-deficit strata are reported as post-trajectory descriptive modifiers and are not adjusted into the primary completion model.
models.uncertainty: Cluster-robust model uncertainty plus 2,000 deterministic scenario-block bootstrap draws for selected marginal contrasts.
models.heldOutPrediction: Five folds assigned by SHA-256 of scenario block; all four arms from a block remain in one fold. Report occurrence/completion Brier, log loss, calibration intercept/slope, ECE, and depth RMSE/MAE.
models.rareEventRule: Use ridge-penalized logistic prediction and bias-reduced descriptive estimates when GEE has separation, nonfinite coefficients, or a predicted probability below 1e-8/above 1-1e-8. Do not delete strata or outcomes.
models.identifiabilityGate: Stop and report if the declared supported-cell fixed design is rank deficient after reference coding, a primary metric has fewer than 25 events and 25 nonevents, a required model remains nonfinite after its declared fallback, or held-out predictions cannot be produced without changing terms. The pre-outcome design matrix must have full rank and condition number below 100 before simulation restarts.

smallNBridge.comparisonRule: Compare direction and support of larger-n empirical strata with S11 small-n summaries, but never pool their rows, coefficients, or denominators. A material sign reversal in completion or detour occurrence within a supported matching stratum triggers a constraining report rather than term deletion.

retention.traceSample: At least 1% of runs selected deterministically before outcomes, retaining accepted-swap metric levels and episode state
retention.unusual: All validation mismatches and all invariant failures; the latter are escalation triggers

validation: exact 24,192 block, 96,768 run, factor, intervention, metric, and pairing accounting
authoritative E01 engine parity for hand fixtures and stratified selected scenarios under identical external opportunities
deterministic full-corpus replay with matching stop, state fingerprint, ledger, distances, episodes, and shadow feasibility
primary-to-long-horizon prefix equality for every required replicate-zero active run
ledger identities, terminal agreement, metric recomputation, and episode fixture checks
calibration, residual, held-out prediction, episode segmentation, threshold, event-budget, rare-event, and separation diagnostics
small-n S11 stratum accounting and explicit exact/empirical evidence separation
all accessed inputs byte-unchanged and no S13 artifact created
escalationTriggers: model identifiability failure under the declared fallback
material conflict with an S11 supported stratum that cannot be explained by the declared exact-versus-empirical boundary
any simulator parity, deterministic replay, prefix, metric, episode, pairing, or immutability failure
any need to drop a declared factor, metric, intervention, censored episode, or repeated scenario
